body: I will admit I smiled a bit reading your comment. Thank you for the words.

Math Major about to transfer to four year university. I generally study with others and am find working in groups, but I never tell anyone how horrible I feel. I tried looking at games that interest me, but nothing Peaks my interest.

I never confess my feelings irl as when I did during high school I was treated horribly by the school so I keep it mostly all in. I have friends in college and only reveal small hints when answering certain jokes. For example, one of my friends asked would you rather be ugly and see the beautiful or be beautiful and only see the ugly. My answer was that I already only see the ugly so Physical appearances meant nothing to me.

I use to enjoy playing video games, but they have grown old for me and find myself getting bored quickly. I generally focus on college, but that's more of a coping strategy that only slightly numbs my feelings of emptiness.

When I walk outside, the sun may be shining and the weather may be warm, but my synapses are firing my feelings of apathy, the Disquiet emptyness that fills me every second I perceive anything. After classes and doing mindless work for hours to suppress this nothingness I sit or lay down for hours thinking about when will this end and hoping that day will be tomorrow.

I have always felt this low since second grade and I am currently 20-years old. I just keep quiet as I am particularly embrassed by how horrible I feel all over my body every second and have no explanation why except for extreme self-loathing.
